messages:
devon: quick heads-up — rc6 private/vpc installer artifacts are uploaded to staging (delta-pack + full-image). aiming for canary tomorrow 02:00 UTC.
maria: thanks. which signer/key are we using for this bundle?
devon: using ops-key-2026-01 (rotated Feb). cosign signatures present. checksum manifest at s3://redwood-artifacts/private/rc6/manifest.sha256
sam: I pulled the manifest, looks good. small nit: one image tag still has `-dev` suffix. we should pin to `rc6-2026-03` before canary.
ashley: agree — can we gate the canary on image pin + deploy-bot green? that avoids surprise drift.
devon: yes — plan: 1) pin image tags 2) run quick smoke on staging 3) deploy-bot start canary (10% routes) 4) observe 30m, then 50% if healthy. fallback = immediate rollback to rc5.
deploy-bot: [automated] preflight checks: artifacts present, cosign OK, manifest checksums OK, image tags unresolved: 1 (private/connector:latest-dev). status: ACTION_REQUIRED
maria: i'll republish that connector image as `private/connector:rc6-2026-03` and update manifest.
ashley: add release-note blurb: "Private/VPC RC6: reduced installer size via delta-pack, signer key unchanged, known issue: KMS rotation not in this window."
sam: tagging and manifest update done -> new manifest SHA: sha256:8f3b...
deploy-bot: [automated] revalidated manifest, all checks passed. ready for canary window at 2026-03-22T02:00Z.
ops-bot: reminder: change window scheduled 2026-03-22 02:00-04:00 UTC. paging channel: #eng-oncall if rollback needed.
maria: who is oncall during the window?
devon: sam will be primary, ashley backup.
sam: i'll be around. quick confirm: rollback playbook is pinned to rc5 tag and we have signed rollforward notes?
ashley: rollback steps in runbook: `deploy-bot rollback --to rc5 --force` plus evict from lb, invalidate KV-cache. i've pasted the condensed commands in the runbook.
devon: adding one more gate: a quality regression check on the prompt-eval must not exceed 2.0% error increase. if threshold breached -> abort canary.
maria: can someone add the prompt-eval test to the deploy-bot gating list?
deploy-bot: ack — added metric `prompt-eval-regression` with threshold 2.0%. will abort canary automatically if triggered.
sam: all set from my side. starting a dry-run tomorrow 00:30 UTC to validate the rollback path.
devon: perfect. final ask: legal needs the release notes snippet for compliance. maria can you drop final blurb by EOD PST?
maria: yes — will post in this thread when done. :white_check_mark:
devon: thanks everyone. ping here when dry-run completes. :thumbsup:
